scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @hero/api" "npm run dev --workspace @hero/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hero/contracts && npm run build --workspace @hero/api && npm run build --workspace @hero/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @hero/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @hero/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @hero/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @hero/api && npm run test --workspace @hero/web
